title: Orb Weaver
topic: How Orb Weaver weaves a website's content, pathways, relationships, and verified actions into an intelligent Website ORB that can guide visitors through the site.
description:
Orb Weaver is a website-intelligence system that studies a website, organizes what it learns, and creates a knowledgeable Website ORB that can guide visitors through the site. Instead of acting like a general chatbot, the ORB understands the website's content, products, services, navigation, funnels, terminology, and approved actions. It can answer questions, identify the next useful step, and guide the visitor toward the correct page, form, product, appointment, or support path.

Orb Weaver transforms a website into a woven system of intelligence.

A website is not merely a collection of pages. It is a web of ideas, products, services, routes, relationships, choices, and destinations. Orb Weaver studies those elements and weaves them together into a structured knowledge system that a Website ORB can understand and use.

It does not simply crawl a website, collect text, and repeat what it finds. It identifies how information connects, how visitors move through the site, which actions matter, where friction occurs, and which destinations can be safely recommended. It maps the language of the business, the relationships between pages, the important entities, the visitor pathways, and the verified buttons, links, forms, and calls to action.

From that weave, Orb Weaver creates a Website ORB that can speak with visitors, answer questions, explain products and services, guide attention, and help people move through the website with less confusion.

The result is not a generic chatbot.
